title: Pure Gearfried
summary: Pure Gearfried build uniting Joey Wheeler's Equip-destroying Warriors with Immortal Phoenix Gearfried, Gearfried the Red-Eyes Iron Knight, and a compact FIRE Warrior Equip engine. By turning Equip Cards into fodder for summons, pops, and monster negates, the deck pairs classic Blast with Chain interactions with modern Warrior bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Sublimation Knight equips Squeaknight from the Deck on Normal Summon; Squeaknight immediately Special Summons itself, putting two FIRE Warriors on the field and an Equip Card in the Spell & Trap Zone or GY for Immortal Phoenix Gearfried.
Infernoble Knight - Renaud Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a FIRE Warrior (treating itself as a Tuner) and recovers a Warrior or Equip Spell from your GY or banishment.
Reinforcement of the Army searches Sublimation Knight, Gearfried the Iron Knight, or Gearfried the Red-Eyes Iron Knight.

summary.title: Opening: Sublimation Knight + Renaud
steps: Normal Summon Sublimation Knight and equip Squeaknight from the Deck, or Special Summon Infernoble Knight - Renaud alongside a Level 4 Gearfried.
Synchro Summon Level 5 Infernoble Knight Captain Roland, activating its effect to send an Equip Spell from Deck to GY and search a FIRE Warrior (Immortal Phoenix Gearfried) during the End Phase.
Banish the Equip Spell from the GY (such as Phoenix Gearblade, which immediately adds itself back to the hand when banished) to Special Summon Immortal Phoenix Gearfried.
On the opponent's turn, use Captain Roland's Quick Effect in the GY to equip itself to Immortal Phoenix Gearfried, giving Phoenix Gearfried face-up Equip fodder for its monster negate.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: The Gearfried Lineup
points: Immortal Phoenix Gearfried (3000 ATK) banishes 1 Equip Spell from your field or GY to Special Summon itself from the hand, equips an opponent's monster to itself at the start of the Damage Step when it attacks, and sends 1 face-up Equip Card you control to the GY to negate and destroy an activated monster effect.

Gearfried the Red-Eyes Iron Knight destroys 1 Equip Card equipped to it once per turn to destroy an opponent's Spell or Trap, and sends 1 Equip Card you control to the GY to revive a Level 7 or lower Red-Eyes monster.

Gearfried the Iron Knight mandatory-destroys any Equip Card equipped to it, immediately triggering Blast with Chain's GY effect to destroy any card on the field, and tributes via Release Restraint to summon Gearfried the Swordmaster from the hand or Deck.
Phoenix Gearfried and Lightray Gearfried provide high-ATK Level 8 Spell/Trap negation.

summary.title: Equip & Trap Synergies
points: Phoenix Gearblade boosts a Warrior by 300 ATK, sends itself to let Level 5+ FIRE Warriors attack twice, and adds itself to your hand whenever sent to the GY or banished for a Warrior's effect.
Red-Eyes Baby Dragon equips from the GY to Gearfried the Red-Eyes Iron Knight and searches a Level 1 Dragon or Red-Eyes monster when sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY.

Blast with Chain and Red-Eyes Fang with Chain double as combat tricks and disruption: Blast with Chain pops any card on the field when destroyed by either Level 4 Gearfried, and Fang with Chain equips an opponent's Effect Monster to your Red-Eyes Iron Knight.

main: Immortal Phoenix Gearfried

Level 9 FIRE Warrior boss that banishes 1 Equip Spell from your field or GY to Special Summon itself, equips an opponent's monster at the start of the Damage Step, and sends 1 face-up Equip Card you control to the GY to negate and destroy a monster effect.
Gearfried the Red-Eyes Iron Knight

Level 4 DARK Warrior that destroys 1 Equip Card equipped to it once per turn to destroy 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls, and sends 1 Equip Card you control to the GY to revive a Level 7 or lower Red-Eyes monster.
Gearfried the Iron Knight
Classic Level 4 EARTH Warrior (1800 ATK) that automatically destroys any Equip Card equipped to it (instantly triggering Blast with Chain!) and tributes via Release Restraint.
Gearfried the Swordmaster
Level 7 LIGHT Warrior (2600 ATK) Special Summoned from hand or Deck via Release Restraint; destroys 1 monster your opponent controls every time an Equip Card is equipped to it.
Phoenix Gearfried
Level 8 FIRE Warrior Gemini that revives a Gemini monster when the opponent activates a Spell and sends 1 face-up Equip Card to negate targeting effects.
Lightray Gearfried
Level 8 LIGHT Warrior that Special Summons itself when you have 5+ LIGHT monsters with different names in your GY and negates Spell/Traps while you control only Warriors.
Red-Eyes Baby Dragon
Equips itself to Gearfried the Red-Eyes Iron Knight to boost its ATK by 300, and searches any Level 1 Dragon or adds a Red-Eyes when sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY by Gearfried!

Equips Squeaknight from the Deck on Normal Summon to provide Warrior bodies and an Equip in the GY for Immortal Phoenix Gearfried.

Infernoble Knight - Renaud

Phoenix Gearblade
